risk_if_not_implemented: Without Development & Test Environment Configurations, Technology Assets, Applications and/or Services (TAAS) may operate with insecure, unauthorized or drifted configurations that expand the attack surface. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Unauthorized Modification / Loss of System Integrity (R-AM-2), and most likely increases susceptibility to Human Error (MT-9).

compensating_control_1.name: Integrity Assurance & Enforcement (IAE)
compensating_control_1.description:
Automated mechanisms exist to:
(1) Identify unauthorized deviations from an approved secure baseline configuration; and
(2) Implement automated resiliency actions to remediate the unauthorized change.
compensating_control_1.justification: Integrity Assurance & Enforcement (IAE) (CFG-08.2) provides configuration hardening that compensates for the absence of Development & Test Environment Configurations (CFG-03.2) by eliminating unnecessary services and enforcing secure settings to reduce inherent exposure. Given the process-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Secure Baseline Configurations
compensating_control_2.description: Mechanisms exist to develop, document and maintain secure baseline configurations for Technology Assets, Applications and/or Services (TAAS) that are consistent with industry-accepted hardening standards.
compensating_control_2.justification: Secure Baseline Configurations (CFG-04) provides configuration hardening that compensates for the absence of Development & Test Environment Configurations (CFG-03.2) by eliminating unnecessary services and enforcing secure settings to reduce inherent exposure. Given the process-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
